name: Hahnenkamm Sunrise Brunch
beschreibung: The legendary Hahnenkamm Brunch on Sonnberg is a gourmet highlight. Enjoy a hearty brunch buffet featuring both regional and international specialties while soaking in the breathtaking views of the Kitzbühel Alps. Live cooking stations and the freedom to choose your own table.
kurzbeschreibung: Luxurious brunch experience on the Hahnenkamm with breathtaking mountain views and exquisite culinary delights.
